svg.title: HP iPAQ h2200 with the HP Photosmart Mobile Camera
svg.desc: An iPAQ h2200 seen from the front with the HP Photosmart Mobile Camera plugged into its SD slot at the top, the lens facing the viewer; animated, the head turns to show its back (10 s loop). The glass rectangle id="screen" is at x=137.5 y=168, 525 x 700.
